steps.description:
Read up the notes on CLASS COMPOSITION AND INHERITANCE.

Click here to view the notes.

The instructor will then brief you on the topic.

You are using multiple classes to create a program for superheroes to compete in an arena. You'll start by making your program randomly choose the combat action for your character.

Create a class named Superhero with the following variables: name <- name of the character combat <- stores the next action: "attacks" or "defends"

The class will have a function select_combat() to decide if it will attack or defend during a combat: 1. It will generate a random number from 1 to 2. 2. If the random number is 1, set combat to "attacks", otherwise set it to "defends". 3. Display the hero's name with its action (e.g. Hulk attacks). The object initialisation will be Superhero(name).

Create a class named Arena with a static function: main() It performs the following: 1. Ask user to input a hero name. 2. Create an object from Superhero class. 3. Call select_combat().

Run Arena.main().

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input

Spiderman

Iron Man

Black Widow

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below: Your result may differ due to random numbers

Example 1 Hero name: Spiderman Spiderman attacks

Example 2 Hero name: Iron Man Iron Man defends

Example 3 Hero name: Black Widow Black Widow attacks

You are using multiple classes to create a program for superheroes to compete in an arena. Your program will randomly choose 2 superheroes and their combat actions each round.

Create a class named Superhero with the following variables: name <- name of the character combat <- stores the next action: "attacks" or "defends"

The class will have a function select_combat() to decide if it will attack or defend during a combat: 1. It will generate a random number from 1 to 2. 2. If the random number is 1, set combat to "attacks", otherwise set it to "defends". The object initialisation will be Superhero(name).

Create a class named Arena with 2 static functions:

fight(hero_list) It takes in a list of Superhero objects and performs the following: 1. Randomly select 2 different heroes and call the their select_combat() function to set their combat action for the next round. 2. Display the result (e.g. Hulk attack vs Black Widow defend) 3. Repeat step (1) to (2) three times.

main() It performs the following: 1. Ask user to input a hero name. 2. Create an object from Superhero class and add it to a list. 4. Repeat step (1) to (2) until user enters "end" for the hero name. 5. Call fight() function to run the combat with the list of heroes for 3 rounds.

Run Arena.main().

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Test Input

Spiderman Iron Man Black Widow end

Hulk Thor Captain America Black Widow end

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the examples below: Your result may differ due to random numbers

Example 1 Hero name: Spiderman Hero name: Iron Man Hero name: Black Widow Hero name: end Spiderman attacks vs Black Widow attacks Iron Man defends vs Black Widow attacks Black Widow attacks vs Spiderman defends

Example 2 Hero name: Hulk Hero name: Thor Hero name: Captain America Hero name: Black Widow Hero name: end Hulk attacks vs Black Widow attacks Thor defends vs Captain America attacks Black Widow defends vs Hulk defends

Marvel, which created almost 8000 superhero characters till date, discovers your secret project on the superhero game. They are willing to pay you $1million to develop the game for them. To show your expertise in object oriented programming, you will use multiple classes to build the codes.

Create a class named Superhero with the following values to be stored:

name      <- name of the character
attack     <- stores the attack power (1 to 9)
defence  <- stores the defend power (1 to 9)
combat   <- stores the next action: "attacks" or "defends" 

The class will have a function select_combat() to decide if it will attack or defend during a combat:

1. It will generate a random number from 1 to 2.
2. If the random number is 1, set combat to "attacks", otherwise set it to "defends".

The object initialisation will be Superhero(name, attack, defend).

Create a class named Arena with 2 static functions:
fight(hero_list) 
It takes in a list of Superhero objects and performs the following:
1. Randomly select 2 different heroes and call the their select_combat() function to set their combat action for the next round.
2. Display who versus who with their selected combat powers (e.g. Hulk defends 5 vs Superman attacks 6)
3. If both are defending or have the same combat power, it is a tie.
4. Display the result (winner or tie) and pause for 1 second.
5. Repeat step (1) to (4) three times.

main()
It performs the following:

1. Ask user to input a hero name and its attack power from 1 to 9.
2. A hero has a total of 10 power points. If the attack power is 7, then the defence power will be 3 (10-7=3).
3. Create an object from Superhero class and add it to a list.
4. Repeat step (1) to (3) until user enters "end" for the hero name.
5. Call fight() function to run the combat with the list of heroes.

Run Arena.main().

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.


Test Input

Spiderman 5 Iron Man 3 Black Widow 6 end

Black Widow 6 Hulk 5 Ant-man 3 Superman 6 end

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the example below: Your result may differ due to random numbers

Example 1 Hero name: Spiderman Attack power (1 to 9): 5 Hero name: Iron Man Attack power (1 to 9): 3 Hero name: Black Widow Attack power (1 to 9): 6 Hero name: end Sipderman attacks 5 vs Black Widow attacks 6 Black Widow wins Iron Man defends 7 vs Black Widow attacks 6 Iron Man wins Black Widow attacks 6 vs Spiderman defends 5 Black Widow wins

Example 2 Hero name: Black Widow Attack power (1 to 9): 6 Hero name: Hulk Attack power (1 to 9): 5 Hero name: Ant-man Attack power (1 to 9): 3 Hero name: Superman Attack power (1 to 9): 6 Hero name: end Ant-man defend 7 vs Black Widow defend 4 tie Hulk attacks 5 vs Ant-man attacks 3
Hulk wins
Black Widow attacks 6 vs Superman attacks 6
tie
